leaves.doc: phisurj: over k = kbar every translation-invariant class (Mumford's Pic0) is a k-point of the identity component of the Picard scheme (Mumford section 8 Thm 1 with section 13; Kleiman, The Picard scheme, section 9.5; locators UNVERIFIED). A consequence of the replaced leaf (tiClassesInPicZeroAC_of_phiSurjective).
leaves.flag: pending reading: Mumford defines Pic0 as the translation-invariant classes; that they are the points of the identity component of the fppf Picard scheme is section 8 Thm 1 with section 13 and Kleiman 9.5, not one print
leaves.source: Mumford, Abelian varieties, section 8 Thm 1 and section 13; Kleiman, The Picard scheme, section 9.5
